description: main.rs reads the DKIM private key seed, builds the DkimSignerArc, then immediately calls zeroize() on the seed bytes before the Arc is cloned to worker tasks. This is correct: the seed material is cleared from memory as soon as it is no longer needed, preventing it from living in heap memory for the lifetime of the process. The use of zeroize here is deliberate and correct.
title: smtp: DKIM seed zeroized immediately after signer construction in main.rs
